cardOverview.overviewText: A Zen Signature card offering accelerated rewards on travel and lifestyle categories, with milestone benefits and global lounge access.

eligibility:
Priority Pass is offered only when the user makes four purchase transactions within 12 months.
If this condition isn't met, you can pay INR 2000 to acquire a Priority Pass.
